author: Andrew Fisher
scope: CPU checks of storage reuse, quality policy and frame lifecycle; not a physical-device FPS benchmark

checks.name: context limits are queried once each, and reset after a context rebuild
static uploads retain their original implementation
dynamic uploads retain exact GPU bytes and reuse all storage at steady size
growth allocates only when capacity is exceeded; shrink and empty draws retain safe counts
quality decreases pixels before sunlight or full detail and never climbs automatically
automatic reductions target smoothness first, retaining a bounded fallback threshold
reinstalling the quality ladder is idempotent
hidden and lost-context callbacks skip GL work; visible callbacks retain the original frame
visibility changes reset elapsed wall time without changing the user pause state
rendering exceptions remain visible to the caller
